prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Choose Your Companion Journey", "Pick a ready-to-play pet for instant fun or design your unique desktop companion.", "Select Path"]
1: ["Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "Your pet is living on your screen now. Use tray controls anytime.", "How to Interact With Your Pet", "Click and drag to move your pet, right-click for options, or double-click to chat.", "Got It!"]
2: ["Upload Photos or Switch to Ready Pets", "Upload clear pet photos or pick a ready-made pet companion instantly.", "Clear, well-lit photos yield the best custom pet results.", "Use Preset Pet Instead"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Account", "Sign in now to sync your new pet and safeguard your adoption profile."]
4: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Companion", "Adopt an animated companion that lives on your desktop, reacts to your day, and keeps you company.", "Start Adoption"]
5: ["For best results, upload 1-3 well-lit photos with clear headshots and single subjects."]
6: ["Creating Your Pet Asset", "Feel free to minimize this window. We will notify you as soon as your pet is ready."]
7: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Complete your pet's name to earn your Founding Companion Badge!", "Founding Pet Parent"]
8: ["Meet Your New Desktop Buddy", "Your pet is active on your screen. Here is your quick command reference."]
9: ["Tip: Right-click your pet on the desktop anytime to hide or customize options."]
